clauses.reason: Terminated by its own terms. Section 1-105 provides that the exemptions granted by the order are for the one-year period beginning October 2, 1981, and ending October 1, 1982. The end date is recorded inclusively as 1982-10-01 (the order runs through the end of that day); on the exclusive reading the exemptions end when October 1, 1982 begins, disclosed for the reviewer (owner ruling 2026-10-21, until-dates). The order exempts each effluent source, emission source, noise-producing activity or facility and solid waste facility at Fort Allen in Puerto Rico from the Federal Water Pollution Control Act, the Clean Air Act, the Noise Control Act of 1972 and the Solid Waste Disposal Act (with listed exceptions) for the temporary housing of Haitian nationals; every exemption in sections 1-101 to 1-104 is limited by section 1-105. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 later revoked the order by number (the table lists 12327, whose subject line describes exempting Fort Allen from pollution control statutes); it is a later event because the order had already ended. No earlier end was found.
